done_when: In .github/workflows/forge-next.yml only the Windows jobs get a 10-minute cap (the others keep 5), so a test over pytest-timeout's limit fails by name in the log; the workflow test pins both caps
why: Windows test group 1 still hits the 5-minute job cap and is cancelled before pytest-timeout can name a slow or hung test, so the log is empty and pull requests need reruns
